$comment: Machine-readable conformance manifest (ES-02-002, ES-65-001). Maps repository units to canonical layers/components, owners, and controls.

units.description: Canonical envelope, header, error catalog, truth-state model, JCS canonicalization, audit hash structure — language-neutral source of truth
Volume 9 Appendix A design-token registry → CSS variables + Tailwind semantic aliases
Principals (human/workload), credentials, sessions, federation port, break-glass
Tenants, Customer Intelligence Domains, scope resolution, governed lifecycle
PDP + policy bundles + POL records; PEP guard lives in shared; internal append port
Hash-chained append-only audit ledger, chain heads allocator, seals, verifier, security intake; internal append port
Canonical object service, schema registry, transactional outbox, commit pipeline
Health/readiness — classified telemetry-only (documented, not a bypass)
WS-19 Platform and Customer Administration shell (access mode, never a truth store)

note_on_component_ids: CP-* namespace is a Volume-4-level extension (ADR-P0-03); Volume 3 Appendix A allocates IDs only for L1-L10 layers.

pinned_images.$comment: Remediation R7/R8 — local Compose infrastructure pinned by immutable digest; CI and the verification harness scan EXACTLY these digests (blocking at HIGH/CRITICAL, .trivyignore carries the dated CVE-level dispositions).

sbom_generator.$comment: Remediation R8 — validated SBOM generator, pinned and tracked; CI fails when the produced SBOM has zero components.

runtime_authorities.$comment: Gate-2 G1 — one database credential per authority. A compromise of the ordinary request path cannot reach any authoritative capability. The break-glass recovery role is deliberately absent from every application pool.
runtime_authorities.eye_commit: governed business writes + bound POL/AUD ports + canonical admission + outbox enqueue
runtime_authorities.eye_publisher: outbox claim + compare-and-set publication acknowledgement only
runtime_authorities.eye_verifier: audit verification, sealing and tamper evidence
runtime_authorities.eye_recovery: break-glass chain-head rebuild — no application pool loads this credential

migration_range: 0001-0010 (0009 and 0010 are governed forward migrations; 0001-0008 unchanged)
